bio.text: Brian Poindexter is the Democratic nominee for Ohio's 7th Congressional District in 2026, challenging Republican Rep. Max Miller.
Poindexter, a union ironworker, is a member of the Brook Park city council and works as an apprenticeship instructor at Ironworkers Local 17, according to the Ohio Capital Journal.

sources.title: Brian Poindexter wants to win on his own terms
